name: Last Rite

origins.name: Tex Balanced Stock
origins.description: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

origins.name: Vanguard's Vindication
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

origins.name: One Quiet Moment
origins.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

origins.name: Gun and Run
origins.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.description:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.description:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

flavor: How will you choose to die?
